chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim, said: I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:

Whoever has intercourse with his woman after the completion of the waiting period, the hadd punishment is administered to him; and if he has intercourse with her before the completion of the waiting period, then his intercourse with her counts as a return (rajʿah).

key_terms.الْعِدَّةِ: the legally prescribed waiting period after divorce
key_terms.امْرَأَتَهُ: his wife or woman in this legal context
key_terms.جُلِدَ الْحَدَّ: the fixed legal punishment is administered
key_terms.رَجْعَةً: a return to the marital bond during a revocable divorce

ai.seo_question: Does intercourse with a divorced wife during the ʿiddah count as rajʿah in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intercourse with a divorced wife during or after her ʿiddah. It states that intercourse before the end of the ʿiddah counts as rajʿah, while intercourse after the ʿiddah has ended is treated as a punishable violation.
